# xterm.js for H3 Studio server terminal

Vendored ES modules and stylesheet from the official npm packages:

- `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0 — `xterm.mjs`, `xterm.css`, `LICENSE.xterm`
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0 — `addon-fit.mjs`, `LICENSE.addon-fit`

Both packages use the MIT license. These files are served locally by Studio; no CDN or browser telemetry is required. Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
